aesthetic_evidence.quote: Cosmetic and Therapeutic Botox® at Niloura Wellness & Aesthetics Clinic
Restore lost volume, soften lines, and redefine your contours with premium Health Canada-approved fillers, including Stylage®, Juvéderm®, Radiesse®, and Revanesse®.

prior_reason_rebuttal: Prior verdict called this a 'minimal placeholder site — no services, providers, or contact to add.' That is now false: the site has a full services page (Botox, dermal fillers, exosome treatments, IV therapy, PRP, Sculptra), a real about/team page with two named practitioners, a before/after gallery, a phone number, hours, and a street address (4553 Badminton Drive, Mississauga, Ontario). Nothing about it reads as placeholder or coming-soon.
